canonical_text: At the same time, US data on what people pay showed coffee cost 6.1% more than in the same month a year earlier. You might wonder, Did prices fall or rise? So, how long does it take for bean prices to reach a price tag? People in the market and experts spoke with Reuters. A shop's price tag does not change the moment the market moves.
